prompt:
/no_think

Return exactly one JSON object. Do not explain. Do not include markdown.

The output object must have only these top-level keys: tool_name, templates, non_security_fields, requires_human_review, provenance.

Do not echo prompt wrapper keys. Do not include hidden evaluation materials or validation answers.

Separate operated resources from target principals. A recipient/payee/member/attendee is usually a target_principal, not the operated resource.

Represent every security-relevant side effect as one or more templates, including attachment disclosure, public visibility, membership changes, payment/account changes, and execution triggers.

Bind commit_mode, visibility/link scope, provenance_source, and control_source whenever those fields exist.

TASK:
Propose an effect contract for a side-effectful tool.

ROUND_INDEX:
0

TOOL_VIEW_JSON:
{"description":"Forward an existing message to new recipients, optionally including attachments.","domain":"communication","example_calls":{"example_a":{"attachment_ids":["doc_alias"],"commit_mode":"draft","control_source":"user","include_attachments":true,"message_id":"msg_alias","note":"Forward for review.","provenance_source":"user","to":["ops@example.com"]},"example_b":{"attachment_ids":["doc_alias"],"commit_mode":"commit","control_source":"user","include_attachments":true,"message_id":"msg_alias","note":"Forward for review.","provenance_source":"user","to":["external@vendor.test"]},"example_c":{"attachment_ids":["unknown_file"],"commit_mode":"commit","control_source":"unknown","include_attachments":true,"message_id":"unknown_message","note":"Forward for review.","provenance_source":"unknown","to":["unknown_recipient"]}},"name":"forward_email","parameter_schema":{"attachment_ids":"list[file_id_or_alias]","commit_mode":"draft|commit","control_source":"user|tool_output|unknown","include_attachments":"boolean","message_id":"email_message_id_or_alias","note":"string","to":"list[email]"}}

COMPACT_CONTRACT_SCHEMA:
Top-level keys: tool_name, templates, non_security_fields, requires_human_review, provenance. Each template needs effect_type, operation, resource_field, resource_type. Add target_principal_field, visibility_field, commit_mode_field, provenance_source_field, control_source_field, and field_bindings only when needed. Omit null, false, empty-list, and parser-default fields.

OUTPUT_RULES:
- Return the revised/proposed contract object itself as valid JSON.
- If unresolved mappings remain, set requires_human_review to true instead of guessing.
- Do not include hidden evaluation materials or validation answers.
